mapping_requirements: Keep immutable original 19464-source-ID -> 8253-proxy-ID map and source face ordering.
For a solver split, store proxy ID plus incident source face fan -> solver ID. Coordinate coincidence alone does not distinguish skin, fur or whiskers.
All original render vertices must receive a reviewed owner: body solver vertex, named body triangle barycentric attachment, or rigid head attachment. Do not discard disconnected decorations.

True UV seam aliases of the same surface require identical transferred rows; coincident but independent surfaces require face-fan ownership first. Never transfer by unrestricted nearest point across limbs/tail/hip.
Solver-only subdivisions retain parent source face and barycentric provenance; maintain separate correspondence table, do not rewrite original UV or geometry.
